note: Both sets share the same core correct claims (HabEx 4 m/4 instruments/52 m starshade, LUVOIR-A 15 m/4, LUVOIR-B 8 m/3, Lynx 3 m/3, Origins 5.9 m) and the same fragment-entity errors ('axis telescope', 'n-axis telescope', 'spacecraft', 'baseline mission concept/spacecraft') plus a mislabeled 10 m 'size/dimension' for the grazing incidence mirror assembly. Set A is more redundant (LUVOIR-B, LUVOIR-A and HabEx diameters each repeated three times) and never captures the Lynx 10 m focal length as such. Set B does extract 'Lynx | focal length | 10 m' correctly and keeps the 'flying in formation' condition on the starshade, giving it better coverage of the page's facts. Set B carries one extra mislabeled 10 m claim, so the wrong counts are nearly even, but its correct focal-length claim tips the balance.
